capabilities: focus the file tree on one folder's subtree
pick a focus folder via search, history or context menu
create, rename, duplicate, delete and reorder files inside focus
restore previous expansion state when clearing focus
navigate the tree with keyboard and drag & drop
extras: Manual installation only: files must be copied into the plugin folder and enabled manually; the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian file explorer with folder focus at its core.
problem: In large vaults, the standard file explorer is cluttered with unrelated folders, attachments and archives that distract from the area you are working in.
summary: File explorer replacement that adds a folder-focus mode which temporarily shows only one folder's subtree in the file tree.
